title: Marhaba Shere Ali
body:
MARHABA SHERE ALI 4
RAN MEI JIS DAM ABU TALIB KA SIPAHI AAYA 2
SHOR UTTHA ASADE SHERE ILAAHI AAYA
AHLE BAATIL KE LIYE BANKE TABAHI AAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
SUNKE YEH FAUJE SITAMGAR ME HAI HULCHUL SI MACHI
DADA WO DEEN THI JAHA AAYE DUHAAI LEKAR 2
BAAP JO SOYE TOH FIR UTTHE KHUDAAI LEKAR
AUR YEH PALTEGA CHULLU ME TARAAYI LEKAR
<<DIVIDER>>
AAJ AAYEGI HAR EK SIMT SE AAWAAZ YAHI
KHUSHK SEHRAAO K DAAMAN ME LAHOO AT JAATE 2
LAASH KE DHER SE MAIDANE WIGA PAT JAATE
AATE JIBREEL TO JIBREEL K PAR KAT JAATE
<<DIVIDER>>
SABR KO ZABT KE EHSAAS NE SONE NA DIYA 2
NEHAR BECHAIN RAHI PYAAS NE SONE NA DIYA
HAAKIME SHAAM KO ABBAS NE SONE NA DIYA
PAHRADAARO KI LABE NEHAR KAMAR TOOT GAYI
<<DIVIDER>>
SIDIYA JISNE BHI ROZE KI UTAR KAR DEKHA 2
USNE NAAYAAB FAZILAT KAA SAMANDAR DEKHA
DEKHNE WALO KI NAZRO NE YEH MANZAR DEKHA
AAJ BHI LIPTI HUI HAI TERE KADMO SE NADI
<<DIVIDER>>
author: Mir Hassan Mir
